mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in the past month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increased industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and real GDP signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate, signals an accommodative monetary policy and a tightening labor market, which together boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with tightening labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accommodative monetary policy and tightening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in the past month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 1% in the past month signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of weakening demand.
